config.hideHerdrSidebar: Hide Herdr's built-in sidebar (spaces and agents) when running in VS Code terminal
config.sessionName: Session name to use when launching Herdr from VS Code terminal (e.g. 'vscode')
config.worktreeLocation: Where to create Git worktrees when launching swarm agents ('sibling' directory or '.worktrees' subfolder)
config.agentHUD.enableNotifications: Show interactive notifications when an agent requires approval or completes a task
config.defaultAgentCommand: Default AI agent command to launch in worktrees (e.g. 'claude', 'agy', 'cursor', 'gh copilot')
config.agentSortOrder: Sort order for active agents in the Agents sidebar: 'grouped' (by workspace) or 'priority' (by urgency/attention queue)
config.codeLens.enable: Show inline CodeLens above test definitions and TODO comments to trigger AI agent assistance
config.quickFix.enable: Show 'Delegate Fix to Herdr Agent' Quick-Fix action in Lightbulb menu for compiler/linter diagnostics
